quiz.title: Non-Relational (NoSQL) Databases
quiz.description: Non-relational database models including document, key-value, column-family, and graph stores, and when to use them.

questions.option_a: A category of databases that don't primarily use the relational table model
questions.option_b: A database that only stores numbers
questions.option_c: A database with no query language at all
questions.correct_answer: A category of databases that don't primarily use the relational table model

questions.question_text: Which of these is a document-oriented NoSQL database?
What is a typical unit of storage in a document database?
questions.option_b: A row in a fixed-schema table

questions.question_text: Which NoSQL data model stores data as simple key-to-value pairs, ideal for caching?
Which of these is commonly used as an in-memory key-value store for caching?
What kind of database is optimized for storing and traversing relationships, such as social networks?
What is a common trade-off NoSQL databases make according to the CAP theorem, compared to strict relational consistency?
questions.option_a: They often favor availability and partition tolerance over strong consistency
questions.option_b: They guarantee perfect consistency at all times
questions.option_c: They cannot be distributed across servers
questions.option_d: They only run on a single machine
questions.correct_answer: They often favor availability and partition tolerance over strong consistency

questions.question_text: Which of these is a wide-column NoSQL store designed for very large, distributed datasets?
What does 'schema-less' mean in the context of many NoSQL databases?
questions.option_a: Documents or records in the same collection can have different fields
questions.option_b: Every record must follow an identical fixed schema
questions.option_c: The database cannot store any data
questions.option_d: Only numeric data can be stored
questions.correct_answer: Documents or records in the same collection can have different fields

questions.question_text: Why might a data engineer choose a NoSQL database over a relational one for a use case?
questions.option_a: The data is unstructured or semi-structured and needs to scale horizontally
questions.option_c: Strict multi-table transactions are the main requirement
questions.option_d: The dataset is small and fits in one table
questions.correct_answer: The data is unstructured or semi-structured and needs to scale horizontally

questions.question_text: What does 'horizontal scaling' mean for a database?
questions.option_a: Adding more machines to distribute the load
questions.option_b: Adding more columns to a table
questions.option_c: Increasing the CPU speed of a single server
questions.correct_answer: Adding more machines to distribute the load
